# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_MEAN_REVERSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday VIX spikes above its 5-minute VWAP indicate temporary fear exhaustion, causing mean reversion. Simultaneously, SPY often pulls back to its 5-minute VWAP during such spikes, creating a long entry opportunity when bullish price action aligns with VIX reversion. This captures intraday mean reversion in both volatility and price.

## Mechanism

Entry: When 5-minute VIX > 5-minute VWAP by ≥0.3 AND SPY price is within ±0.1*ATR(14) of its 5-minute VWAP AND the 5-minute candle is bullish (close > open). Exit: Chart stop at low of entry bar (or VIX spike high if lower), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed at 12% from highest-water-mark. Regime filter: VIX > 18 and time between 09:30-11:30 EST.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% headline P&L scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 used 16-month SPY/VIX 5-minute bars (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with BS-synthetic pricing (not real OPRA). High overfit risk due to regime sensitivity (VIX>18 filter) and intraday timing constraints.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window executed; Stage-1 is in-sample only).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (Stage-1 used BS-synthetic pricing; no real OPRA validation).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 2025-Q1 (-$1300.5); max drawdown: $4701.52; blow-up scenario: prolonged low-VIX (<15) trending markets causing repeated false VIX mean-reversion signals.
6. **Concentration:** Top 5 days = 99.9% of P&L (from Stage-1: 2026-05-04 alone contributed 804.72 of -$1464.23 wide P&L, but note losing days skew percentage; actual concentration extreme due to strategy's infrequent trading).
